run_habitat_train: run a habitat baseline experiment in train mode using a config YAML file
run_habitat_eval: run a habitat baseline experiment in eval mode using a config YAML file
execute_exp_with_config: execute a habitat experiment by loading a config and running the registered trainer
run_exp_with_opts: run a habitat experiment with a config file and optional command line overrides
main_cli_entry: run the habitat baselines CLI to train or evaluate with an experiment config
